selected_primary_idea.title: Resolution-Aware Arrow-of-Time Attribution Benchmark
selected_primary_idea.summary: A cross-family, multiresolution inference benchmark that separates genuine nonequilibrium dissipation from preparation, hidden-state, coarse-graining, and record-formation artifacts.
selected_primary_idea.research_object: Finite trajectory ensembles with declared generator, system boundary, observation map, and reversal protocol.
selected_primary_idea.mechanism: Joint evaluation of forward/reverse likelihood asymmetry, entropy-production consistency, fluctuation-relation residuals, record persistence, and resolution stability.
falsifiability: Instability under valid resolution or nuisance perturbations.
Failure of the applicable fluctuation-relation check.
Inability to define a symmetric reversal operation.

competitive_ideas.title: Record-Persistence and Entropy Ledger
competitive_ideas.reason_not_primary: Strong for record formation but insufficiently discriminative for the cosmological boundary condition.

high_risk_ideas.title: Gravitational-Entropy Toy-Model Comparator
high_risk_ideas.reason_high_risk: Useful for exposing boundary-condition dependence, but gravitational-entropy definitions remain model dependent.

rejected_ideas.title: Universal entropy-score explanation of time
rejected_ideas.reason: Violates the Survey separation between dissipation, records, coarse graining, and initial conditions.

simulated_search_trace.outcome: Selected RAAT with explicit failure conditions.
